items.content_text: Alejandro González Iñárritu cast the Hollywood star as a bombastic Texas oil baron in “Digger,” bringing the actor back to art-house cinema after almost two decades focused largely on action blockbusters.

items.title: Heard on the Street: A blood test that could screen for dozens of cancers at once moved closer when an FDA panel backed Grail’s Galleri multi-cancer test
items.content_text: An FDA panel backed Grail’s Galleri test. But the Medicare money the business depends on is far from guaranteed.

items.title: The Trump administration is rolling out a program aimed at getting Medicare to match drug prices in other countries for certain high-cost drugs, such as cancer and autoimmune disorder medicines
items.content_text: The program to tie U.S. drug costs to prices in other nations is less ambitious than initially proposed after deals with drugmakers.

items.title: Grip strength is increasingly being viewed as an important biomarker of our overall strength and fitness, explains Your Health columnist Sumathi Reddy
items.content_text: A simple squeeze can give you information about your muscle strength and future health risks.

items.title: Rapid weight loss can come with a downside: muscle loss. Drugmakers are testing a new generation of muscle-protecting and body fat-targeting drugs to fix that.
items.content_text: Drugmakers are targeting muscle preservation and fat loss as they build the next generation of weight-loss medications.

items.title: A next-generation weight-loss drug from Eli Lilly, when combined with Zepbound, helped people lose substantially more weight than Zepbound alone, according to a new study
items.content_text: A drug combination studied in people with Type 2 diabetes lowered blood sugar and helped people lose more weight than with Zepbound alone.
